assets.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a production website illustration asset for the Sell / Trade-in banner of an automotive dealer template. Transparent background, landscape composition approximately 3:1. A photorealistic graphite-grey modern European executive estate car in a front three-quarter view pointing slightly left, complete vehicle with all wheels and mirrors visible. Beside the car, a single realistic black and satin-metal key fob in the lower-left foreground, modest scale, visually associated with selling a vehicle. Car occupies most of composition, key occupies no more than 20% width. Restrained high-end studio photography with soft daylight reflections, crisp readable vehicle silhouette and details that work at 150px wide. Short subtle contact shadows only, fully transparent surrounding canvas. Tight composition with about 5% clear space around subject on all sides. No cash, coins, hands, people, extra vehicles, pedestal, arrows, labels, slogans, license-plate text, brand logos, watermark, decorative gradients or background scenery. This is reusable illustrative artwork, not a photograph of actual dealer stock. Keep natural materials and proportions; no cartoon or toy effect.
